messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
అలా నా ఆత్మ, ఇంకా ఎగురుతూ, వెనక్కి తిరిగి ఆ పాస్‌ను మళ్లీ చూసింది అది ఎప్పుడూ జీవించి ఉన్న వ్యక్తిని విడిచిపెట్టలేదు.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Telugu)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Telugu → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | così | “so / thus” (resultative) | **అలా** | “so / thus” | OK | | l'animo | “the soul / spirit” | **ఆత్మ** | “soul” | OK | | mio | possessive “my” | **నా** | “my” | OK | | ch'ancor | relative “which” + adverb “still” | **ఇంకా** | “still” (relative sense understood) | OK | | fuggiva | imperfect “was fleeing / flying” | **ఎగురుతూ** | “flying / fleeing” | OK | | si | reflexive clitic (the subject acts on itself) | **తిరిగి** | “turned back” (reflexive sense) | OK | | volse | past “turned” | **తిరిగి** | “turned back” | OK | | a (1) | preposition introducing direction (to) | **వెనక్కి** | “backward” (direction) | OK | | retro | noun used adverbially “back” | **వెనక్కి** | “backward” | OK | | a (2) | preposition introducing infinitive purpose | **మళ్లీ** (part of “again”) | “again” (purpose marker) | **UNNECESSARY** (Telugu does not need a separate preposition here) | | rimirar | infinitive “to look again” | **చూది** | “looked” (with “again” supplied by మళ్లీ) | OK | | lo | definite article “the” | **ఆ** | “the” | OK | | passo | “the pass” (object) | **పాస్‌ను** | “the pass‑ACC” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which” | **అది** | “which / that” | OK | | non | negation “not” | **ఎప్పుడూ** | “never” (covers both non + mai) | OK | | lasciò | past “left” | **విడిచిపెట్టలేదు** | “did not leave” | OK | | già | adverb “already” | — | — | **MISSING** | | mai | adverb “never” | **ఎప్పుడూ** | “never” (already expressed) | OK | | persona | noun “person” | **వ్యక్తిని** | “person‑ACC” | OK | | viva | adjective “living” | **జీవించి ఉన్న** | “living (present participle)” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING:** `già` – the notion “already” is not rendered in the Telugu version. - **UNNECESSARY:** the second `a` (preposition before the infinitive) – Telugu expresses the purpose without a separate preposition; the meaning is already carried by the verb phrase “మళ్లీ చూసింది”.
No grammar mismatches or wrong translations were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 25: - Original: అలా నా ఆత్మ, ఇంకా ఎగురుతూ, - Issue: none - Corrected: అలా నా ఆత్మ, ఇంకా ఎగురుతూ,
- Line 26: - Original: వెనక్కి తిరిగి ఆ పాస్‌ను మళ్లీ చూసింది - Issue: none - Corrected: వెనక్కి తిరిగి ఆ పాస్‌ను మళ్లీ చూసింది
- Line 27: - Original: అది ఎప్పుడూ జీవించి ఉన్న వ్యక్తిని విడిచిపెట్టలేదు. - Issue: Missing “already” (già) - Corrected: అది ఇప్పటికే ఎప్పుడూ జీవించి ఉన్న వ్యక్తిని విడిచిపెట్టలేదు.
